passages.text: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
passages.sermon:
All the tribes of Israel came to David.
They came to him at Hebron.
They spoke to David.
They said, “We are your own flesh and blood.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ כָּל־ שִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד חֶבְר֑וֹנָה וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנְנ֛וּ עַצְמְךָ֥ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

passages.text: Even in times past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And to you the LORD said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’ ”
passages.sermon:
David was a leader in Israel.
Saul was king over Israel in the past.
Even then, David led Israel out to battle.
David also brought Israel back safely.
The LORD spoke to David.
The LORD said, “You will shepherd My people Israel.”
The LORD also said, “You will be ruler over Israel.”
passages.original: גַּם־ אֶתְמ֣וֹל גַּם־ שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם בִּהְי֨וֹת שָׁא֥וּל מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֗ה הָיִיתָה מוֹצִיא וְהַמֵּבִי אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לְךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְנָגִ֖יד עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where King David made with them a covenant before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel.
passages.sermon:
All the elders of Israel came to King David at Hebron.
King David made a covenant with the elders at Hebron.
He did this before the LORD.
The elders anointed David as king over Israel.
passages.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹ֣ת לָהֶם֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֥ד בְּרִ֛ית בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֧וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֛ד לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
passages.sermon: David became king when he was thirty years old.\r\nDavid reigned as king for forty years.
passages.original: בֶּן־ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה דָּוִ֖ד בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה מָלָֽךְ׃

passages.text: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
passages.sermon:
David was king.
He ruled in Hebron.
He ruled over Judah there.
He ruled in Hebron for seven years and six months.
He also ruled in Jerusalem.
He ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.
In Jerusalem, he ruled over all Israel and Judah.
passages.original: בְּחֶבְרוֹן֙ מָלַ֣ךְ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם מָלַ֗ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land. The Jebusites said to David: “You will never get in here. Even the blind and lame can repel you.” For they thought, “David cannot get in here.”
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David had men with him.
David and his men marched to Jerusalem.
The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem.
The Jebusites spoke to David.
They said, “You will not enter here.”
They said, “Even the blind and the lame can keep you out.”
The Jebusites believed David could not enter the city.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וַֽאֲנָשָׁיו֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל־ הַיְבֻסִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְדָוִ֤ד לֵאמֹר֙ לֹא־ תָב֣וֹא הֵ֔נָּה כִּ֣י אִם־ הֱסִֽירְךָ֗ הַעִוְרִ֤ים וְהַפִּסְחִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ יָב֥וֹא דָוִ֖ד הֵֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
passages.sermon: David was king.\r\nDavid captured the fortress of Zion.\r\nThe fortress of Zion is the City of David.
passages.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֣ד דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃

passages.text: On that day he said, “Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who are despised by David.” That is why it is said, “The blind and the lame will never enter the palace.”
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
On that day, David spoke to his men.
He said, “Whoever attacks the Jebusites must go up the water shaft.
He must strike the lame and the blind.
David despised the lame and the blind who mocked him.
Because of this, people say, ‘The blind and the lame will never enter the house.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא כָּל־ מַכֵּ֤ה יְבֻסִי֙ וְיִגַּ֣ע בַּצִּנּ֔וֹר וְאֶת־ הַפִּסְחִים֙ וְאֶת־ הַ֣עִוְרִ֔ים שָׂנְאוּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ דָּוִ֑ד עַל־ כֵּן֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ עִוֵּ֣ר וּפִסֵּ֔חַ לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־ הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: So David took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built it up all the way around, from the supporting terraces inward.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David lived in the fortress.
David named the fortress the City of David.
David built around the fortress.
He built from the supporting terraces inward.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב דָּוִד֙ בַּמְּצֻדָ֔ה וַיִּקְרָא־ לָ֖הּ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּ֤בֶן דָּוִד֙ סָבִ֔יב מִן־ הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וָבָֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD God of Hosts was with him.
passages.sermon:
David was king over Israel.
David became greater.
David continued to grow in greatness.
The LORD God of Hosts was with David.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram sent envoys to David.
Hiram sent cedar logs to David.
Hiram sent carpenters to David.
Hiram sent stonemasons to David.
The carpenters and stonemasons built a palace for David.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח חִירָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֥ר מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל־ דָּוִד֒ וַעֲצֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֣י עֵ֔ץ וְחָֽרָשֵׁ֖י אֶ֣בֶן קִ֑יר וַיִּבְנֽוּ־ בַ֖יִת לְדָוִֽד׃

passages.text: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
passages.sermon:
David was king over Israel.
The LORD had established David as king.
The LORD had made David’s kingdom strong.
The LORD did this for His people Israel.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔ד כִּֽי־ הֱכִינ֧וֹ יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכִי֙ נִשֵּׂ֣א מַמְלַכְתּ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: After he had arrived from Hebron, David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David came to Jerusalem from Hebron.
After he arrived, David took more concubines from Jerusalem.
David also took more wives from Jerusalem.
More sons were born to David.
More daughters were born to David.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ דָּוִ֨ד ע֜וֹד פִּֽלַגְשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י בֹּא֣וֹ מֵחֶבְר֑וֹן וַיִּוָּ֥לְדּוּ ע֛וֹד לְדָוִ֖ד בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon, Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
passages.sermon:
David was king over Israel.
He lived in Jerusalem.
David had children born to him in Jerusalem.
Their names were Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
Their names also included Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, and Japhia.
Their names also included Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמ֛וֹת הַיִּלֹּדִ֥ים ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְשׁוֹבָ֔ב וְנָתָ֖ן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃ וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישׁ֖וּעַ וְנֶ֥פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃ וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וְאֶלְיָדָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃פ

passages.text: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they all went in search of him; but David learned of this and went down to the stronghold.
passages.sermon:
David was anointed king over Israel.
The Philistines heard about this.
All the Philistines went to look for David.
David heard what the Philistines were doing.
David went down to the stronghold.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי־ מָשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֤ד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּעֲל֥וּ כָל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִ֔ד וַיֵּ֖רֶד אֶל־ הַמְּצוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.sermon: The Philistines were a group of enemies of Israel.\r\nThe Philistines came to the land near Jerusalem.\r\nThey spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁ֖וּ בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃

passages.text: So David inquired of the LORD, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” “Go,” replied the LORD, “for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to the LORD.
David asked the LORD a question.
David said, “Should I go up against the Philistines?”
David also asked, “Will You give the Philistines into my hand?”
The LORD answered David.
The LORD said, “Go.”
The LORD said, “I will surely give the Philistines into your hand.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤ד בַּֽיהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶֽעֱלֶה֙ אֶל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הֲתִתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיָדִ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ דָּוִד֙ עֲלֵ֔ה כִּֽי־ נָתֹ֥ן אֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: So David went to Baal-perazim, where he defeated the Philistines and said, “Like a bursting flood, the LORD has burst out against my enemies before me.” So he called that place Baal-perazim.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
The Philistines were his enemies.
David went to a place called Baal-perazim.
David fought the Philistines at Baal-perazim.
David defeated the Philistines there.
David said, “The LORD has broken through my enemies before me like a bursting flood.”
David named that place Baal-perazim.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א דָוִ֥ד בְּבַֽעַל־ פְּרָצִים֮ וַיַּכֵּ֣ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִד֒ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר פָּרַ֨ץ יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ אֹיְבַ֛י לְפָנַ֖י כְּפֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים׃

passages.text: There the Philistines abandoned their idols, and David and his men carried them away.
passages.sermon: The Philistines left their idols there.\r\nDavid and his men took the idols.\r\nThey carried the idols away.
passages.original: וַיַּעַזְבוּ־ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׂאֵ֥ם דָּוִ֖ד וַאֲנָשָֽׁיו׃פ

passages.text: Once again the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.sermon: The Philistines were Israel’s enemies.\r\nThey came up again to attack.\r\nThey spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.original: וַיֹּסִ֥פוּ ע֛וֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לַֽעֲל֑וֹת וַיִּנָּֽטְשׁ֖וּ בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃

passages.text: So David inquired of the LORD, who answered, “Do not march straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David wanted to know what to do.
David asked the LORD for guidance.
The LORD answered David.
The LORD said, “Do not go straight up to the Philistines.
Go around behind them.
Come against them from the front of the balsam trees.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל דָּוִד֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א תַעֲלֶ֑ה הָסֵב֙ אֶל־ אַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם וּבָ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם מִמּ֥וּל בְּכָאִֽים׃

passages.text: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, because this will mean that the LORD has marched out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD leads David.
The LORD commands David in battle.
The Philistines are Israel’s enemies.
The LORD fights against the Philistines.

You will hear a sound.
The sound will be like marching.
The sound will come from the tops of the balsam trees.
When you hear this sound, act quickly.
Move forward without delay.
This sound means the LORD has gone ahead of you.
The LORD has gone to strike the camp of the Philistines.
passages.original: וִ֠יהִי בְּשָׁמְעֲךָ אֶת־ ק֧וֹל צְעָדָ֛ה בְּרָאשֵׁ֥י הַבְּכָאִ֖ים אָ֣ז תֶּחֱרָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אָ֗ז יָצָ֤א יְהוָה֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לְהַכּ֖וֹת בְּמַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: So David did as the LORD had commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
The LORD gave David a command.
David obeyed the LORD.
David fought the Philistines.
David defeated the Philistines.
He struck them down from Gibeon to Gezer.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ דָּוִד֙ כֵּ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִגֶּ֖בַע עַד־ בֹּאֲךָ֥ גָֽזֶר׃פ
